data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with various Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Includes line chart for LLM cost over time.
Bar chart for stage completion rates.
Area chart for success rate trends.

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js for data visualizations in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Includes pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates visualizations.
Utilizes various chart types like line, bar, area, pie, and radar charts.
Charts are animated and interactive.

features.title: 8-Stage Pipeline Visualization
features.description: Develop a visualization of the 8-stage pipeline using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Each stage of the pipeline is clearly represented.
Visualization is interactive and informative.
Pipeline stages are accurately depicted.

features.title: Results Display
features.description: Show real metrics from recent runs using actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are displayed accurately and clearly.
Data is up-to-date and relevant.
Results are integrated into the presentation in a cohesive manner.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML presentation using existing demos as templates.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation is a single HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript.
Uses templates from specified directory as a base.
Includes professional gradient background and smooth transitions.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics like TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart accurately displays code quality metrics.
Metrics are clear and easy to understand.
Chart is integrated seamlessly into the presentation.

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides automatically advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate through slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents integration data.
Chart is interactive and visually appealing.
Data is up-to-date and relevant.

features.title: HERO Slide Development
features.description: Create a HERO slide introducing Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Slide clearly explains what Artemis is.
Visually appealing with professional design elements.
Integrates seamlessly with the rest of the presentation.
